tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on base, mantle, crust and surface0..2 (14:1 on base, 11.7:1 on surface1).

tokens.name: subtext1
tokens.usage: Secondary copy one step down from text; on any background or surface step.

tokens.name: subtext0
tokens.usage: Muted copy, metadata and operators; on base, mantle, crust and the surfaces (9.5:1 on base).

tokens.name: overlay2
tokens.usage: Comments and placeholder text; 5.7:1 on base, 4.6:1 on surface1.

tokens.name: overlay1
tokens.usage: Structural glue: inactive borders, punctuation, subtle labels. 4.4:1 on base, so never body copy; the repo gives it a 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: overlay0
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative hairlines only: 2.8:1 on base, below every text floor.

tokens.name: surface2
tokens.usage: The highest surface step: hover on a surface1 row, pressed quiet buttons.

tokens.name: surface1
tokens.usage: Raised controls at rest: quiet buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: surface0
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on base; the hairline between base and a card.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: The page. Blackwater's main background, the first ground every text token is checked on.

tokens.name: mantle
tokens.usage: Sidebars, headers and the second pane; the card surface the status tints are mixed over.

tokens.name: crust
tokens.usage: The deepest pane: window chrome, the ground under a floating panel, and the dark text on a bright fill (cursor text, mark text, text on the error fill).

tokens.name: blossom
tokens.usage: Dusty rose: variables in code, terminal colour 17. Reads 11.6:1 on base.

tokens.name: petal
tokens.usage: Pale pink: functions in code and the cursor. Reads 10.7:1 on base.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: THE brand pink. The triangle in the logo's A, keywords in code, the tab indicator and selection tint. Reads 7.5:1 on base; as text, on base, mantle, crust or surface0 only.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Lilac: types in code, the second mark colour.

tokens.name: cranberry
tokens.usage: Error. 6:1 on base, 4.9:1 on surface1; as a fill, pair with crust (ui-on-error).

tokens.name: cherry
tokens.usage: Emphasis: matched text in lists and titles; half of the focus ring mix. 7.2:1 on base.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: Warm orange: terminal colour 16, the warm half of property and removed-diff mixes.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Warning and numbers in code; the bell. 11.4:1 on base.

tokens.name: gooseberry
tokens.usage: Success and strings in code. 11.4:1 on base.

tokens.name: juniper
tokens.usage: Info and regex in code. 10.6:1 on base.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Links, in prose and code. 9:1 on base, 7.4:1 on surface1.

tokens.name: bilberry
tokens.usage: Sky blue: the third mark colour.

tokens.name: blueberry
tokens.usage: Constants in code.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Namespaces in code, the first mark colour, and the search-hit tint.

tokens.name: jam
tokens.usage: The fill: buttons, badges, progress, the accent and active borders. Set by the fill equation to clear base by 3.3:1 (3.8:1 here). Never a text colour.

tokens.name: onjam
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a jam fill (4.8:1). The only white in the system.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Blackwater's badge colour in listings and the tab indicator; the same value as berry, kept as its own name so a tint of the palette can move it.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The wordmark's ink in the supplied logo, for light grounds only (1.05:1 on base). On dark grounds use the on-dark edition, whose ink is text.

tokens.name: ui-background
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ui-pane-secondary
tokens.usage: Sidebars, headers, cards' ground for status tints.

tokens.name: ui-pane-tertiary
tokens.usage: Window chrome and the deepest pane.

tokens.name: ui-text
tokens.usage: Text you read, on every background and surface.

tokens.name: ui-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text.

tokens.name: ui-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Labels and glue at the 3:1 floor; not reading copy.

tokens.name: ui-accent
tokens.usage: Focus and activity: active borders, the selected item's marker. Non-text, 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: ui-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on ui-accent.

tokens.name: ui-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button, badge and progress fills.

tokens.name: ui-on-fill
tokens.usage: Label on ui-fill.

tokens.name: ui-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: mix(cherry, overlay1, 0.5). Solid 2px, 5.6:1 on base, 4.6:1 on surface1.

tokens.name: ui-border-active
tokens.usage: Border of the focused pane or input.

tokens.name: ui-border-inactive
tokens.usage: Border of an unfocused pane or input; 4.4:1 on base.

tokens.name: ui-cursor
tokens.usage: Text cursor.

tokens.name: ui-cursor-text
tokens.usage: Text under the cursor block.

tokens.name: ui-selection
tokens.usage: Selected text: berry at 18% into base. Syntax colours keep 65% of their minimum on it.

tokens.name: ui-line-current
tokens.usage: Cursor line: surface0 at 35% into base.

tokens.name: ui-link
tokens.usage: Links in prose and code.

tokens.name: ui-success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons; pair with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: ui-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons; changed lines in diffs.

tokens.name: ui-error
tokens.usage: Error text, icons and the destructive fill.

tokens.name: ui-on-error
tokens.usage: Text on a cranberry fill (6.5:1).

tokens.name: ui-info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons.

tokens.name: ui-error-surface
tokens.usage: Faint error tint behind cranberry text: 6% of ui-error over mantle. cranberry reads 5.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: ui-warning-surface
tokens.usage: Faint warning tint behind honey text: 6% over mantle.

tokens.name: ui-info-surface
tokens.usage: Faint info tint behind juniper text: 6% over mantle.

tokens.name: ui-mark1
tokens.usage: First highlight mark; the current search match.

tokens.name: ui-mark2
tokens.usage: Second highlight mark.

tokens.name: ui-mark3
tokens.usage: Third highlight mark.

tokens.name: ui-mark-text
tokens.usage: Text on any mark fill.

tokens.name: ui-tab-indicator
tokens.usage: The active tab's underline or bar.

tokens.name: ui-on-tab-indicator
tokens.usage: Text on a tab-indicator fill.

tokens.name: ui-badge
tokens.usage: Count badges and chips that mean 'active'.

tokens.name: ui-on-badge
tokens.usage: Text on ui-badge.

tokens.name: ui-emphasis
tokens.usage: Matched characters in filtered lists; titles that need weight without jam.

tokens.name: ui-search-matches
tokens.usage: Every search hit but the current one: lavender at 22% into base.

tokens.name: ui-diff-added
tokens.usage: Added line ground: gooseberry at 18% into base.

tokens.name: ui-diff-changed
tokens.usage: Changed line ground: honey at 10% into base.

tokens.name: ui-diff-removed
tokens.usage: Removed line ground: syntax-diff-removed at 18% into base.

tokens.name: ui-diff-text
tokens.usage: The changed span inside a changed line: honey at 18% into base.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords. Warm berries carry structure.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Functions and methods.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Types and classes.

tokens.name: syntax-namespace
tokens.usage: Modules and namespaces.

tokens.name: syntax-constant
tokens.usage: Constants and builtins. Cool tones carry values.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings.

tokens.name: syntax-regex
tokens.usage: Regular expressions.

tokens.name: syntax-variable
tokens.usage: Identifiers.

tokens.name: syntax-property
tokens.usage: Object keys: mix(apricot, subtext0, 0.3), a warm grey quieter than functions.

tokens.name: syntax-operator
tokens.usage: Operators, one step above comments.

tokens.name: syntax-punctuation
tokens.usage: Brackets and commas, quieter than comments.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, deprecated and unimplemented code.

tokens.name: syntax-link
tokens.usage: URLs in code.

tokens.name: syntax-error
tokens.usage: Squiggles and error tokens.

tokens.name: syntax-diff-removed
tokens.usage: Removed text in diffs: mix(cranberry, apricot, 0.5), six OKLab units from ui-error.

families.display: "Alte DIN 1451 Mittelschrift", Bahnschrift, "Barlow Semi Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
families.display-embossed: "Alte DIN 1451 Mittelschrift gepraegt", "Alte DIN 1451 Mittelschrift", Bahnschrift, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark set in type when the SVG cannot be used; hero titles. Uppercase, as the logo.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Deeper surfaces, the same berries as Mire.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A bog-witch berry theme, at its darkest.
styles.usage: Reading copy. ui-text on any background.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text, in ui-text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, badges and tab names.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and terminal text; the syntax-* colours apply here.

spacing.note: A 4px scale. Darkberry's ports carry no spacing of their own; these steps were chosen for BlackMatter's UI.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, chip padding, the gap under a label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, input padding, gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks on a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

radius.note: Sharp. The logo is cut, not rounded, and the Darkberry site rounds nothing past 2px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, tab indicators, code spans. The site's only radius.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges only.

shadow.note: Depth comes from the surface steps, not shadows: a floating panel sits on crust with a surface0 border.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers over the page, the one allowed shadow: crust at 80%.
